caption: The video captures two women in clear turquoise water beside a sandy beach, filmed handheld. The left woman wears a white visor, sunglasses, a teal swimsuit, and a necklace, while the right woman wears a straw visor, sunglasses, and a teal swimsuit. A white fence, palm trees, and a pale beach house shift across the frame as the camera tilts. The left woman turns her head toward her companion, glances downward, then rotates back toward the camera. The right woman's mouth opens and closes, and her head rides high before settling lower near the waterline. Sun-glitter and ripples move across the surface around their shoulders and arms. An orange buoyant object becomes visible beside the right woman and remains near her as the framing drifts. Both women remain side by side, bobbing gently in the water as the handheld view continues.
